description: Java class defining a custom exception 'ConnectionSignalIdEnforcementFailedException' used when enforcement of a Signal ID (e.g., a Thing ID) fails in the Eclipse Ditto connectivity model. Includes builder pattern, JSON parsing, and error handling.
